youtube_description:
ShotByHype Brings you The Best High School Baseball Content On Youtube! Be sure to hit that Subscribe Button if you Enjoy!

A Few Weeks ago I took a flight out to Portland, OR to film with Will from The Baseball Bat Bros. We filmed this episode, and a Day In The Life Episode that will drop on Friday this week. Will goes over all the Bats, and Gear he brings to a typical Shoot. You see that Brands he is rocking with, and some drop equipment he has. Make sure to Leave a Thumbs Up, Comment, and Subscribe to the channel so I can Continue to Travel and film with more people! Make sure if you haven't yet to Subscribe to @baseballbatbros Channel!

Make sure to give them a Follow on Social Media @TheBaseballBatBros & Follow me as well on Social Media to stay up to date on where & who I am filming with Next! @ShotByHype 

How you can help support the Bat Bros:
1) Buy a Baseball Bat Bros shirt/hat/hoodie at: https://baseballbatbros.com/​
2) Become a Bat Bro YouTube Member.
3) If you're looking to buy a bat, head over to BaseballBatBros.com to see our Top 10 BBCORs of the year and click our referral link/button next to the Bat Bro Scale image to make your purchase.
4) Donate via Venmo: @baseballbatbros

Thanks For Watching!
